name: Cable-Assisted Nordic Hamstring Curl
steps: Kneel facing away from a high pulley, secure your ankles under the machine’s fixed pad and hold the handle at your chest.
Squeeze your glutes and brace your abs so your body forms a straight line from knees to head.
Lower your torso slowly forward from your knees, using your hamstrings to resist gravity while the cable offsets part of your weight.
Contract your hamstrings forcefully to pull yourself back upright to tall kneeling while holding your hips straight.
tips: Keep a straight line from knees through shoulders rather than hinging at your waist.
Use just enough counterweight to control the entire lowering and lifting range cleanly.
